ULTHUB.Panel.Update.Title: Update to {version}
ULTHUB.Panel.Update.Why: Foundry installs and updates modules only from its Setup screen, not from inside a running world. The short way:
ULTHUB.Panel.Update.Step1: Return to the Setup screen (in the sidebar, under the game settings).
ULTHUB.Panel.Update.Step2: Open the module list (Add-on Modules) and find this module.
ULTHUB.Panel.Update.Step3: Press Update next to it — if nothing is offered, check for updates first — then launch the world again.
ULTHUB.Panel.Install.Title: Install this module
ULTHUB.Panel.Install.Step2: On the Setup screen, open the module list (Add-on Modules) and press Install Module.
ULTHUB.Panel.Install.Step3: Paste the link into the Manifest URL field, press Install, then enable the module in your world.

ULTHUB.Settings.CheckOnStart.Name: Check for updates when entering the world
ULTHUB.Settings.CheckOnStart.Hint: The Game Master's browser asks GitHub in the background once the world has loaded. Only the Game Master ever sees update information. Has no effect while the setting below is "Only when I ask".
ULTHUB.Settings.CheckInterval.Name: Remember a check for
ULTHUB.Settings.CheckInterval.Hint: How long the Hub keeps GitHub's answer before it asks again. GitHub allows only a limited number of requests per hour, so longer is kinder. "Only when I ask" turns automatic checks off completely.
ULTHUB.Settings.ShowToolbox.Name: Show the Hub button in the toolbox
ULTHUB.Settings.ShowToolbox.Hint: Adds a button to the token tools on the left. The Hub can also be opened from this module's settings page.
ULTHUB.Settings.TileSize.Name: Tile size
ULTHUB.Settings.TileSize.Hint: Large tiles show the whole picture and description; compact tiles fit more modules into a small window.
